about.kicker: A day built around good music and good smoke
paragraphs: Southern Star Festival brings live country music and a full-blown BBQ cook-off together on one Hill Country farm for one day. Bring the family, bring your appetite, and settle in under the Texas sky for a lineup of bands, a backyard-to-blue-ribbon smoker competition, and food and drink from local vendors all day long.
Whether you're here for the music, the meat, or both, there's shade, seating, and something going on from gates-open to the last encore.

bbq.cookoffText: Team entries are open through April 24. Entry includes your cook site, water, and a shot at grand champion. Categories: brisket, ribs, sausage, and chicken. Email SouthernStarEventsTx@gmail.com if interested!

location.title: Southern Star Farms
paragraphs: Maxwell, TX : about 20 minutes south of San Marcos and 45 minutes from both Austin and San Antonio. $10 parking on-site, with free shuttle service running from the overflow lot every 30 minutes from at 2PM-6PM and shuttle back from 6PM-10PM.
Coolers and outside drinks aren't permitted, but plenty of water stations and vendors will be on-site all day.

faq.a: Yes. The festival runs rain or shine; the cook-off tents and Barn Stage are covered, and Main Stage has a canopy roof.

faq.q: Can I bring my own cooler or drinks?
faq.a: Outside food, drinks, and coolers aren't allowed, but there's plenty of food and drink from vendors and the cook-off tasting area all day.
Of course! Bring the paw-friends. You're completely responsible for cleaning, feeding, and making sure their safe!

faq.q: How do I enter the BBQ cook-off?
faq.a: Head to the BBQ Cook-Off section above for entry details, or email SouthernStarEventsTx@gmail.com to reserve your team's spot.
On-site parking is $10, with a free shuttle running from the overflow lot starting at 2 PM.
